title: Amazon soars as cloud revenue surge allays fears over ballooning AI bets
byline: Deborah Mary Sophia and Kanchana Chakravarty
excerpt: Amazon shares surged nearly 14% on Friday after the tech giant's solid cloud sales growth reinforced investor confidence in its massive AI ‌bets and quashed...
content_html:
By Deborah Mary Sophia and Kanchana Chakravarty

July 31 (Reuters) - Amazon shares surged nearly 14% on Friday after the tech giant's solid cloud sales growth reinforced investor confidence in its massive AI ‌bets and quashed any concerns about the company trailing its Big Tech rivals in the AI ‌race.

The e-commerce and cloud titan posted its strongest cloud growth in over four years, indicating a fresh wave of demand that justifies ​its 10% increase in planned capital spending for 2026 to $220 billion.

Amazon's results come as a resounding sign to Wall Street that some of Big Tech's AI investments are already generating measurable returns.

If gains hold, the stock could add more than $340 billion in market value on the back of a 37% jump in second-quarter cloud revenue. Earlier this week, ‌Microsoft surged more than 15% after ⁠its cloud unit beat estimates with a 43% revenue jump.

However, there's a growing divide in investors' tolerance for the ever-increasing AI spend by Big Tech, set to exceed $730 billion ⁠this year.

"The market is no longer questioning whether AI demand is real. The new dividing line is whether unprecedented spending is producing visible, near-term revenue and margin expansion," said Bill Birmingham, managing director at REX Financial.

"The market penalizes spending ​when monetization ​is delayed, indirect or difficult to measure."

Meta and Google-parent ​Alphabet both slumped 7%, despite strong growth in ‌revenues, after the companies raised their capital spending forecasts while free cash flows cratered.

"Amazon is earning the right to keep spending. Where others are asking investors to trust that the payoff will come, Amazon showed it this quarter," said Thomas Monteiro, senior analyst at Investing.com.

"As long as AWS keeps accelerating and margins hold, the market looks willing to fund the build-out, even with free cash flow in the red."

Amazon's free cash flow swung ‌sharply negative in the quarter, with the company burning $7.6 billion on ​a trailing 12-month basis, versus $18.2 billion in positive free cash flow ​a year earlier.

Still, CEO Andy Jassy reassured ​investors that Amazon is only pouring money into serving demand that already exists. He said ‌a majority of available Amazon cloud capacity ​for 2027 and some capacity ​for 2028 had already been reserved by customers.

Chris Ballard, managing partner at Check Capital, said Amazon's approach to spending was "methodical and responsible."

"This level of capital deployment is all very new, so Amazon showing immediate ​results is a really good sign."

content_html_zh:
作者：黛博拉·玛丽·索菲亚和 Kanchana Chakravarty

7 月 31 日（路透社）——周五，亚马逊股价飙升近 14%，此前这家科技巨头云销售的强劲增长增强了投资者对其大规模人工智能押注的信心，并消除了对该公司在人工智能竞赛中落后于大型科技竞争对手的担忧。

这家电子商务和云巨头公布了四年多来最强劲的云增长，表明新一轮需求浪潮证明了其 2026 年计划资本支出增加 10% 至 2200 亿美元是合理的。

亚马逊的业绩对华尔街来说是一个响亮的信号，表明大型科技公司的一些人工智能投资已经产生了可衡量的回报。

如果涨幅保持不变，随着第二季度云收入增长 37%，该股的市值可能会增加超过 3400 亿美元。 本周早些时候，微软的云部门收入增长 43%，超出预期，股价飙升超过 15%。

然而，投资者对大型科技公司不断增加的人工智能支出的容忍度却越来越大，今年预计将超过 7300 亿美元。

“市场不再质疑人工智能需求是否真实。 新的分界线是前所未有的支出是否正在产生可见的近期收入和利润扩张，”REX Financial 董事总经理比尔·伯明翰 (Bill Birmingham) 表示。

“当货币化延迟、间接或难以衡量时，市场会对支出进行惩罚。”

Meta 和谷歌母公司 Alphabet 尽管收入强劲增长，但在自由现金流大幅下降的情况下提高了资本支出预测后，这两家公司的股价均下跌了 7%。

“亚马逊正在赢得继续消费的权利。 当其他人要求投资者相信回报将会到来时，亚马逊在本季度就证明了这一点，”Investing.com 高级分析师托马斯·蒙泰罗 (Thomas Monteiro) 表示。

“只要 AWS 继续加速发展并且利润率保持不变，市场看起来就愿意为扩建提供资金，即使自由现金流出现赤字。”

亚马逊本季度的自由现金流急剧负值，该公司过去 12 个月烧钱 76 亿美元，而一年前的正自由现金流为 182 亿美元。

尽管如此，首席执行官安迪·贾西（Andy Jassy）向投资者保证，亚马逊只是将资金投入到满足已经存在的需求中。 他表示，客户已经预留了 2027 年大部分可用的亚马逊云容量和 2028 年的部分容量。

Check Capital 管理合伙人克里斯·巴拉德 (Chris Ballard) 表示，亚马逊的支出方式“有条不紊且负责任”。

“这种水平的资本部署都是非常新的，因此亚马逊立即显示出结果是一个非常好的迹象。”
